problem: The definition of ε‑closure only adds states reachable by a single ε‑move, missing the transitive closure over any number of ε‑moves.
fix: Define ε‑closure(X) as the smallest superset of X that contains every state reachable from any state in X by any number (zero or more) of ε‑moves. For example: ε‑closure(X) = X ∪ { r | ∃ p∈X, p --ε⁺--> r }.

problem: The transition for DFA state {p,r} on input symbol 1 is shown as ∅, but according to the NFA it should go to {p,r}. This contradicts the worked example.
fix: Change the table entry for state {p,r} under column 1 to {p,r} (or S0) instead of ∅.

problem: It states that the empty set ∅ is added as a dead state for missing transitions, but all transitions for symbols 0 and 1 are already defined, so the dead state is unnecessary for completeness.
fix: Clarify that a dead state ∅ is added only if there are missing transitions for some symbols; in this particular example it is not required.
